about.title: We Are 510 Cleaning
about.subtitle: Professional foam cleaning for electronics and furniture in Kigali, Rwanda.
about.storyText1: 510 Cleaning Services was founded by a university student in Kigali who saw a real problem — people had expensive electronics and furniture that needed professional care, but no reliable, affordable service existed.
about.storyText2: We started with a simple idea: bring professional foam cleaning technology directly to your home or office. No fixed prices, no hidden fees — just honest service discussed via WhatsApp before we arrive.
about.value1Text: We use dry foam technology that cleans deeply without using water — completely safe for electronics.
about.value2Text: Our cleaning products are safe for sensitive electronics, fabric, and wooden furniture.
about.value3Text: We serve all areas of Kigali. Book online and we arrive at your location.
about.value4Text: We respond to every quote request within 2 hours, Monday to Saturday.
about.founderText: This platform is built and operated by a student at a Kigali university. We understand the needs of students, professionals, and families in the city — and we are committed to delivering quality service at fair prices discussed personally with each customer.

contact.responseTime: We respond to quote requests within 2 hours.
contact.locationText: We cover all neighborhoods in Kigali including Kacyiru, Kimihurura, Nyarutarama, Gisozi, Remera, Kicukiro, and more.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Body: We collect information you provide when making a booking: your name, phone number, email address, and service address. We also collect information about your device and how you use the platform to improve our services.
privacy.sec2Body: We use your information to process your booking request, contact you about your service, send confirmation emails, and improve our platform. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.sec3Body: Your data is stored securely on Neon PostgreSQL servers. Authentication is managed by Clerk. Email communications are sent via Resend. All providers follow industry-standard security practices.
privacy.sec4Body: You can request to view, update, or delete your personal data at any time by contacting us via WhatsApp. We will respond within 7 days.
privacy.sec5Body: We use essential cookies for authentication and user preferences (theme and language). We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.sec6Body: If you have questions about your privacy or this policy, please contact us:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.sec1Body: By using 510 Cleaning Services platform, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.sec2Body: 510 Cleaning Services provides professional foam cleaning for electronics and furniture in Kigali. All prices are quote-based and discussed via WhatsApp before any service is performed. No payment is charged through the platform.
terms.sec3Body: A booking request is not a confirmed appointment until our team contacts you to confirm the date, time, and agreed price. We reserve the right to refuse any booking for any reason.
terms.sec4Body: You can cancel a pending booking at any time through your dashboard. We ask that cancellations be made at least 2 hours before the scheduled service time.
terms.sec5Body: 510 Cleaning Services uses professional dry foam technology that is safe for electronics and furniture. However, we are not responsible for pre-existing damage to items. Our team will inspect items before cleaning and note any existing issues.
terms.sec6Body: For any questions about these terms, please contact us:
